decisions.reason: ACE3 is promoted as the firm's new industry-standard control and monitoring solution for its core airfield lighting business, and with industry turnover growing and the firm hiring and doing its own R&D, results appear to meet aspirations and slack is available, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.

The air situation display extends the firm's tower and surveillance offer within its integrated-operations strategy, and although the evidence of its performance is thin, growth and organisational slack let the firm carry it while its results remain uncertain.
